metadata.question: Does the green leaf area in China increase during 2017 compared to 2000?

data.raw_code: The question is about comparing green leaf area in China between 2017 and 2000. This is a vegetation analysis question where I should use NDVI (Normalized Difference Vegetation Index) as a proxy for green leaf area. Strategy: 1. Use MODIS vegetation indices (MOD13Q1 or MOD13A1) which provide NDVI data 2. Define China geometry - I'll use a simple bounding box for China 3. Compare annual mean NDVI for 2000 vs 2017 4. Handle potential data gaps and cloud masking Data considerations: - MOD13Q1 (250m, 16-day) or MOD13A1 (500m, 16-day) are good choices - Need to check if data exists for both years - Calculate mean NDVI for each year and compare Validation: - Check collection sizes - Check valid pixel counts - Ensure NDVI values are in valid range (-1 to 1) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const china = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([73.5, 18.0, 135.0, 53.5]); // China bounding box // 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS NDVI const modis2000 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD13A1') .filterBounds(china) .filterDate('2000-01-01', '2000-12-31') .select('NDVI'); const modis2017 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD13A1') .filterBounds(china) .filterDate('2017-01-01', '2017-12-31') .select('NDVI'); // Check collection sizes const size2000 = modis2000.size().getInfo(); const size2017 = modis2017.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2000 Images: ${size2000}, 2017 Images: ${size2017}`); if (size2000 === 0 || size2017 === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Create annual mean composites const ndvi2000 = modis2000.mean().multiply(0.0001); // Scale factor for MODIS NDVI const ndvi2017 = modis2017.mean().multiply(0.0001); // 3. Check valid pixels const count2000 = ndvi2000.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: china, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); const count2017 = ndvi2017.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: china, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid pixels - 2000: ${count2000}, 2017: ${count2017}`); if (count2000 === 0 || count2017 === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // 4. Calculate mean NDVI values const mean2000 = ndvi2000.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: china, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); const mean2017 = ndvi2017.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: china, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); console.log(`Mean NDVI - 2000: ${mean2000?.toFixed(4)}, 2017: ${mean2017?.toFixed(4)}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (mean2000 === null || mean2017 === null || isNaN(mean2000) || isNaN(mean2017) || mean2000 < -1 || mean2000 > 1 || mean2017 < -1 || mean2017 > 1) { console.log("C3"); return; } const ndviChange = mean2017 - mean2000; console.log(`NDVI Change: ${ndviChange.toFixed(4)}`); if (ndviChange > 0) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
